title: 第9章 不敢就滚一边去第10章 你这是在劝我吗
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: “孩儿需要用落星城的天才，证明我不是废物，证明唐家人没有废物！”
唐天眼眸之中闪烁锋芒，声音低缓，却十分坚定。
他是一个执着倔强的人，正好原本的“唐天”
，性格虽然内向一些，可也同样十分执着倔强。
说出这一句话后，唐天竟然胸口一道郁结之气消散，有一种心念通达的感觉，十分舒畅。
“好一个我唐家人没有废物！”
唐凌云听到唐天的话，不由得一愣，随即朗声大笑起来。
再看向唐天的目光，更多了几分欣慰。
还有几分深深的忧虑，隐藏在深处，无人发现。
要用落星城的天才，证明自己不是废物，这句话说出来需要莫大的勇气，可要做到的话，可不是有勇气就够了。
唐凌云身为落星城第一强者，也无法想象，唐天究竟会用什么办法，在一个月后，能够以炼脉境的修为，与锻骨境高阶的林逸尘决一死战？
唐天拜别了唐凌云，一个人独自回到了属于自己的小院。
身为唐家家主的儿子，虽说是个人人鄙夷的废物，可这待遇，却是丝毫不差。
每个月都会领到一千枚下品元石，以及各种用于修炼的丹药。
元石分为下品元石、中品元石、上品元石，以及极品元石。
元石是修者修炼的资源，也是这个世界修者之间买卖交易用的货币。
修炼的丹药对于前世身为炼丹师的唐天，根本没有放在眼里。
身为唐家少主，每个月领到的修炼资源，足以让唐家任何一个同辈族人为之眼红。
若唐天是一个天才的话，自然没人会说什么，偏偏到了十五岁，都还是一个炼脉境的废物，这就让很多人心里不平衡了。
尤其是唐啸海的儿子唐风，是目前唐家年轻一代最杰出的天才，对唐天占用资源更不爽。
唐天回到房间之后，便开始运功疗伤。
林逸尘那一拳的威力，很强，伤害到了经脉。
此时此刻，落星城因为四个消息沸腾了起来。
第一个消息，唐家废物少爷主动退婚，丝毫不给秦家脸面，这倒是出乎了很多人的意料。
第二个消息，林家林逸尘当着唐家的面，对秦家提亲，秦家也答应了下来，正准备择日完婚。
第三个消息，林逸尘居然是落星宗的内门弟子，这在落星城这种小地方，可是独一份啊！
仅仅只是这一个身份，就让落星城很多人有了不一样的想法和打算。
第四个消息，唐家废物少爷唐天，与林逸尘对了一拳，仅仅只是受伤，同时还提出了一个月之后生死之战！
这四个消息，一个比一个劲爆，一个比一个让人震惊难以置信！
当然，落星城中，唏嘘声一片。
所有的言语，几乎是一边倒。
所有人都在嘲讽唐天不自量力，一个废物也能和林逸尘这样的天骄一较高下？
蚍蜉撼树！
粪坑里点灯，找死！
可以说，原本就对唐天嗤之以鼻的人，现在更是感觉他不仅是一个一无是处的废物，更是一个不知死活的白痴。
唐天却不在乎这些说法，时间紧迫，他必须在一个月之内，提升修为，斩杀林逸尘。
因此在房间疗伤结束后，便准备前往落星森林历练修行。
唐天刚出了院落，迎面走来了一群少年。
为首的少年，眼眸犀利，锋芒毕露，气势惊人，正是唐啸海之子，唐风。
“你这个废物，占用唐家的资源也就罢了，却还要做有辱我唐家脸面的事情。
唐天，我要是你，我早就找个地方了结自己。”
唐风挡住了唐天的去路，冷笑一声。
content_en:
"My child needs to use the genius of Luo Xing City to prove that I am not a waste, and prove that the Tang family is not a waste!"
Tang Tian's eyes flashed with sharpness, and his voice was low but firm.
He is a persistent and stubborn person, just like the original "Tang Tian"
, although his personality is more introverted, he is also very persistent and stubborn.
After saying these words, Tang Tian felt that the stagnation in his chest dissipated, and he felt that his thoughts were clear, and he was very comfortable.
"It's a good thing that our Tang family has no waste!"
When Tang Lingyun heard Tang Tian's words, he couldn't help but be stunned, and then laughed loudly.
Looking at Tang Tian again, he felt even more pleased.
There is also some deep worry, hidden deep in the depths, no one can find it.
To use the genius of Fallen Star City to prove that he is not a waste, it takes a lot of courage to say this, but to do it, courage is not enough.
As the strongest man in Falling Star City, Tang Lingyun couldn't imagine what method Tang Tian would use to fight to the death with Lin Yichen, a high-level Bone Forging Realm, in a month's time with his cultivation at the Pulse Refining Realm?
Tang Tian bid farewell to Tang Lingyun and returned to his own courtyard alone.
As the son of the head of the Tang family, although he is a trash that everyone despises, his treatment is not bad at all.
Every month, he will receive a thousand low-grade Yuan stones, as well as various elixirs for cultivation.
Yuan stones are divided into low-grade Yuan stones, medium-grade Yuan stones, high-grade Yuan stones, and extremely high-grade Yuan stones.
Yuan Stone is a resource for cultivators to practice, and it is also the currency used for transactions between cultivators in this world.
Tang Tian, ​​who was an alchemist in his previous life, did not pay any attention to the elixirs he cultivated.
As the young master of the Tang family, the training resources he receives every month are enough to make any of his peers in the Tang family jealous.
If Tang Tian was a genius, naturally no one would say anything. However, at the age of fifteen, he was still a waste in the Pulse Refining Realm, which made many people feel unbalanced.
Especially Tang Xiaohai's son Tang Feng, who is currently the most outstanding genius of the younger generation of the Tang family, is even more unhappy with Tang Tian's use of resources.
After Tang Tian returned to the room, he began to perform exercises to heal his injuries.
The power of Lin Yichen's punch was so strong that it hurt the meridians.
At this moment, Falling Star City was in a state of excitement because of four pieces of news.
The first news was that the good-for-nothing young master of the Tang family took the initiative to break off the engagement without giving any face to the Qin family. This surprised many people.
The second news was that Lin Yichen of the Lin family proposed marriage to the Qin family in front of the Tang family. The Qin family also agreed and was preparing to choose a date to get married.
The third piece of news is that Lin Yichen is actually an inner disciple of Luo Xing Sect, which is unique in a small place like Luo Xing City!
Just this identity makes many people in Falling Star City have different thoughts and plans.
The fourth news is that Tang Tian, ​​the good-for-nothing young master of the Tang family, punched Lin Yichen and was only injured. At the same time, he also proposed a life and death battle in a month!
These four pieces of news are more exciting than the last, and more shocking and unbelievable than the last!
Of course, there were a lot of sighs in Falling Star City.
All words are almost one-sided.
Everyone was mocking Tang Tian for overestimating his abilities. How could a loser compete with a genius like Lin Yichen?
The worm shakes the tree!
Light a lamp in a cesspool and seek death!
It can be said that people who originally scorned Tang Tian now feel that he is not only a worthless waste, but also an idiot who does not know how to live or die.
Tang Tian didn't care about these claims. Time was running out. He had to improve his cultivation and kill Lin Yichen within a month.
Therefore, after finishing the treatment in the room, he prepared to go to the Falling Star Forest to practice practice.
As soon as Tang Tian left the courtyard, a group of teenagers came towards him.
The young man in the lead had sharp eyes, a sharp edge, and an astonishing momentum. He was none other than Tang Feng, the son of Tang Xiaohai.
"You're a waste, you just take up the resources of the Tang family, but you still want to do things that disgrace the face of our Tang family.
Tang Tian, if I were you, I would have found a place to kill myself long ago. "
Tang Feng blocked Tang Tian's way and sneered.
